steps.explain: The calls enter with remaining values 2, 1 and 0.
The frame at 0 records the base event and returns first.
The frame at 1 resumes and records its leave event before the outer frame at 2 does the same.

problems.fingerprint: frame-state-shared|direct|function visit(remaining, events) { events.push('enter:' + remaining); if (remaining === #) { events.push('base'); return; } visit(remaining - #, events); events.push('leave:' + remaining); } const events = []; visit(#, events); console.log(events.join('|'));

steps.explain: The root is entered first and pauses while its children are visited in source order.
The east leaf enters and leaves before the west branch begins.
The desk leaf leaves, then west resumes and leaves, and finally the root resumes and leaves.

problems.fingerprint: unwind-order-reversed|direct|function visit(node, events) { events.push('enter:' + node.id); for (const child of node.children) visit(child, events); events.push('leave:' + node.id); } const org = { id: 'root', children: [ { id: 'east', children: [] }, { id: 'west', children: [{ id: 'desk', children: [] }] } ] }; const events = []; visit(org, events); console.log(events.join('|'));

visibleTests.testCode:
// The zero boundary is the next value below this stopping point.
assert.deepStrictEqual(traceRetrySchedule(), ['try-3>try-2>stop']);

steps.explain: The first call begins with three remaining attempts and emits try-3.
The next call begins with two and emits try-2; the call at one immediately satisfies the stopping condition.
The stop marker returns without emitting try-1, so the displayed trace contains only two attempts.

problems.fingerprint: base-case-off-by-one|direct|function retrySchedule(remaining) { if (remaining <= #) return ['stop']; return ['try-' + remaining, ...retrySchedule(remaining - #)]; } console.log(retrySchedule(#).join('>'));

steps.explain: The north invocation starts at depth zero and its child frame records depth one.
That recursive walk returns before flatMap invokes routeDepth for south.
The south invocation receives its own zero depth argument and produces a separate child frame at depth one.

problems.fingerprint: sibling-frame-state-carryover|direct|function routeDepth(region, depth) { if (depth === #) return [region + ':' + depth]; return [region + ':' + depth, ...routeDepth(region + '-child', depth + #)]; } const routes = ['north', 'south'].flatMap((region) => routeDepth(region, #)); console.log(routes.join('|'));

hiddenTests.name: includes every direct and nested folder amount

steps.explain: The root begins with 2 and visits its two child folders in array order.
The first child returns 1; the second child adds its own 3 to the nested child value 4 and returns 7.
The root adds both child results to 2 and prints 10; empty child lists add no further calls.

problems.fingerprint: branch-result-omitted|direct|function quota(folder) { if (folder === null) return #; let total = folder.own; for (const child of folder.children) { total += quota(child); } return total; } const tree = { own: #, children: [ { own: #, children: [] }, { own: #, children: [{ own: #, children: [] }] } ] }; console.log(quota(tree));
